subject.title: feat: Cron job tags/categories for organization and filtering

question: Should cron organization use freeform tags, a typed purpose/display metadata contract, or a narrower reminder-first classifier as the durable API shape?
rationale: The request changes persisted cron schema, Gateway protocol, UI/CLI filters, and possibly plugin/reminder contracts, and a member already closed the generic metadata PR pending an owner-reviewed design slice.

options.title: Typed classification contract
options.body: Add a narrow typed purpose/display metadata model first, then expose tag-like filtering only where it fits the shared UI/API model.

options.title: Freeform tags contract
options.body: Accept the requested `tags: string[]` API as the durable user/plugin-facing contract and wire it through all cron surfaces.

options.title: Reminder-first slice
options.body: Implement only the reminder/non-reminder classifier now and defer general tags/categories to a later API discussion.

recommendation.title: Typed classification contract
recommendation.body: Add a narrow typed purpose/display metadata model first, then expose tag-like filtering only where it fits the shared UI/API model.

likelyOwner.reason: He left the clearest prior design-direction signal on the related cron metadata PR and is tied to adjacent compact cron protocol work.
